description: DuckDuckGo web search: the organic results (url, title, plain and HTML snippet, result types, host, sublinks, date, site name, rating) and the other blocks of the same answer: ads, related searches, the knowledge panel, the AI answer when DuckDuckGo gives it inline, and the news, image and video strips. Blocks DuckDuckGo did not send are empty lists or null. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

page.description: The results page, from 1. The first page holds 10 results, every later page 15; positions continue across pages.
page.title: Page

region.description: A DuckDuckGo region code such as us-en, de-de or uk-en; wt-wt is no region.
region.title: Region

time.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year, or from a date range YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD.
time.title: Time
